text: The sixth voice is the thread itself. The Loom totem is the last Resonance Totem, and it comes from the March: **Loom Thread** from the Ancestor Halls, and a heart from The Unsung.

pages.title: Finding the thread
text: The sunken Ancestor Halls in the March Steppe and Highlands keep Loom Thread in their two chests. Read the four tablets on your way out.
The Loom-stitchers also trade a thread to Friends, for six March Crystals.

Carve a **Loom Seal**: a Blank Seal and one Loom Thread, shapeless. Seated in a Ritual Brazier with the Loom voice and Pulse within **8 blocks**, it threads **2 Pulse** into a Pulse Cell you carry every **two seconds** while you stand within **6 blocks**, with Luck. The brazier spends **8 Pulse** a beat to do it.

pages.title: Before the totem
text: Build Echo Unweave: March Stone around two Copper Resonators, a Spirit Shard and a Loom Thread. It needs the Loom voice within 8 blocks. Until you can craft the totem, build it beside a Loom totem that already stands in a Loom-stitcher camp, an Ancestor Hall or a Crystal Spire.
Then wake The Unsung at a Drum Circle and take its **Unsung Heart**.

steps.caption: A Pulse Resonator and Echo Unweave, a few blocks apart.
Place the Loom totem within 8 blocks of both.
Unweave can now work, and the Resonator hears one more distinct voice.

pages.title: What Loom opens
text: Craft the Loom totem from four March Crystals, two Loom Thread and two March Planks around the Unsung Heart.
With Loom in reach, Echo Unweave turns ingots back into echoes, cores into ingots, Spiritweave into wool and damaged Spiritgear tools and weapons into a Manifested Ingot.
The Sixfold Staff gains Tether and, sneaking with no target, Stitch. The Ley Binding rite needs the Loom Seal, and Far Gates need the Loom voice.
